name: superskills
description: Curated AI coding skills with a Google/Meta-quality workflow (TDD, DRY, SOLID). The Codex plugin install exposes the coding pack; other packs install via ./setup --packs into ~/.codex/skills.

interface.shortDescription: TDD, debugging, review, QA and security skills
interface.longDescription: Curated engineering skills with a Google/Meta-quality workflow: test-driven development, systematic debugging, code review and clean-code passes, full per-feature QA, security testing, spec and planning workflows, and knowledge-base integration. The plugin install exposes the core skills; ./setup installs the full set (gstack, design, marketing) into ~/.codex/skills.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my superskills install is healthy.
Run the full QA pipeline on this branch before I ship it.
